faces.name: Kjeldoran War Cry
faces.oracleText: Creatures you control get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is 1 plus the number of cards named Kjeldoran War Cry in all graveyards.

faces.name: Kjeldoran Warrior
faces.oracleText: Banding (Any creatures with banding, and up to one without, can attack in a band. Bands are blocked as a group.
